entries.3770e45e07840b99: Mitsui Fudosan is a company that acquires land itself and builds structures, and it divides the ways it earns from using them into four types. If it keeps the buildings it constructs and leases them to tenants, the income is rent from the Leasing Business. If it sells them, the income is sales from the Sales Business. If it does not own them and instead takes on management and brokerage of other companies' buildings, the income is fees from the Management Business. If it operates facilities itself, such as hotels and stadiums, the income is sales from the Facility Operations Business. Construction work commissioned by other companies is limited to new-build contracting and renovation, among other work, in the 'Other' segment operated by Mitsui Home Co., Ltd. and others. Its revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥247.3 billion, which does not reach one-tenth of consolidated revenue of ¥2.7097 trillion.
